user.title: Kindle Panel
user.description: Which Music Assistant connection should the panel use for full play queues?

abort.single_instance_allowed: Kindle Panel is already set up.

data_description.names_he: Hebrew for names that have no row of their own (the room labels of lights, the amplifier and TV, ...), one per line (YAML), e.g. 'Dining room: פינת אוכל'. Lights, rooms, plugs, scene buttons, custom tabs and their toggles have a Hebrew name field in their own rows.
data_description.tabs: Order and presence of the tabs on the panel (at most 6). Custom tabs are created under Custom tabs; a tab removed here keeps its setup and can be added again.

data.scenes: Scene buttons (in screen order: F1, F2, F3)

data_description.scenes: Up to 3 buttons on the Lights tab (F4 stays 'All off'). Each runs an HA scene or script (make scenes in Settings → Scenes). The names Bright, Evening and Movie show in Hebrew by themselves; any other name takes its Hebrew from the row's Hebrew name.

data_description.plugs: energy_to_wh converts the energy sensor to Wh (1 for Wh, 1000 for kWh).
data_description.key_f1: What the four keys under the Power tab do: switch a plug, switch all plugs off, or nothing. A plug added above can be picked after saving and opening this page again.

media.title: Media tab and music
media.description: The Media tab lists your media devices (nodes); the music screen plays through Music Assistant on the player picked on the panel (its own player picker; groups are made in Music Assistant). The amp's NET RADIO dial is on the amp's own device screen.

data.show_unavailable_outputs: Player picker: also list unavailable players (debugging)
data.hidden_outputs: Player picker: never list these players
data.inputs_for: Then rename / hide the inputs of
data.discover_key: Discover on the music screen's free key

data_description.nodes: One row per device. Type receiver: Entity = the receiver's media player (power, inputs); optional volume number, plug, stream output select (DLNA/AirPlay) and the Music Assistant players it plays (the panel's player among them turns the receiver on first). Type tv: Entity = the TV's media player; optional movie mode scripts and boolean. Id: a-z, 0-9, _ (keep it once chosen; the F-keys use it).
data_description.key_f1: Music screen, a device's controls, a script, all off or nothing. Devices added on this page are offered after saving and reopening it.
data_description.out_f1: Quick keys in the player picker: a Music Assistant player or group (picks it), a script (runs it, e.g. plug on, amp on, input SERVER, output DLNA; see the README), or nothing.
data_description.show_unavailable_outputs: Off (default): the picker lists only players that can be chosen now. On: unavailable players and Music Assistant players without a Home Assistant entity (MA's Expose to Home Assistant is off, e.g. a browser's web player) are listed greyed.
data_description.hidden_outputs: Music Assistant players the Kindle's picker leaves out (e.g. a phone). Players hidden in Music Assistant itself (its "Hide player" setting) are left out anyway. The panel's current player is always listed; the F-key dropdowns above still offer every player.
data_description.inputs_for: Pick a device (or type the id of one added above) to go on to its inputs: the list comes live from its media player (source_list), in the device's order; rename an input (e.g. CD -> Bluetooth & TV) or hide it. Both pages are saved together there.
data_description.library_tabs: The Kindle's library is a Music Assistant client: its tabs are Music Assistant's library sections, always in this order (the strip shows the first four, the rest are under More). A tab Music Assistant has no provider for (e.g. Audiobooks) is left out anyway.
data_description.library_tab: The tab the library opens on (default Playlists); a tab that is not shown falls back to the first one.
data_description.discover_key: On (default): the music screen's free soft key opens Discover (Music Assistant's Home rows: recently played, favourites, recommendations). Off: no Discover key.
data_description.discover_rows: The rows Discover shows, always in this order; a row with fewer than 2 items is left out, each row holds up to 20 items. Recommendations = the other rows Music Assistant's recommendation providers return (Library Recommendations, Last.fm, MusicBrainz), in Music Assistant's order. Podcasts / audiobooks (off by default) also let podcast / audiobook items into the other rows.

media_inputs.title: Inputs of {name}
media_inputs.description: {entity} lists: {inputs}. Every input shows on the panel with the device's own title unless a row renames or hides it. Rows of inputs the device does not list right now are kept.

data.cards: Cards on the photo (up to 3, in this order)
data.unsplash_key: Unsplash access key (optional; empty keeps the stored one)

data_description.sources: Any picture folder Home Assistant knows: Immich favourites, an Immich album, person or tag, local media, … Left empty, Immich favourites are shown.
data_description.mode: F1 on the panel keeps a photo (good on e-ink), F4 skips it for good. Skipped photos are never shown.
data_description.cards: Outdoor (weather), Indoor (temperature + humidity), Calendar, or Sensor: any entity, with a label and an icon.
data_description.fallback: Black-and-white photos from Unsplash, or the built-in sample photo. Used while no photo source has a photo.
data_description.unsplash_query: What the Unsplash photos show (needs an access key).
data_description.unsplash_key: Free at unsplash.com/developers. With a key the photos match the search; without one they are random black-and-white Unsplash photos (via Lorem Picsum).

custom_tabs.title: Custom tabs
custom_tabs.description: Tabs of your own: up to 4 toggles (switch, light, helper, fan) and F1..F4 for anything. A new tab is added at the end of the tab bar; move or hide it in General → Tabs. Deleting a row deletes the tab and its setup.

data.edit: Then edit the toggles and keys of

data_description.edit: Pick a tab (or type the id of one created above) to go on to its toggles and F1..F4; both pages are saved together there.

custom_tab.title: Custom tab: {title}
custom_tab.description: Up to 4 toggles in screen order; Enter on a row switches it. Next: the F1..F4 keys.

custom_tab_keys.title: Custom tab: {title}, keys
custom_tab_keys.description: What the four keys under this tab do.

data_description.key_f1: A toggle of this tab (switches it), any scene or script (runs it), all toggles of this tab off, or nothing.

error.invalid_config: Not saved, the value is not valid: {error}

abort.custom_tab_gone: That custom tab no longer exists.
abort.media_node_gone: That media device no longer exists.

options.curate: Not judged yet first, then the kept ones

get_queue.name: Get play queue
get_queue.description: The whole play queue of a Music Assistant player (paged), with the current index.

play_index.name: Play queue item
play_index.description: Jump to item n (0-based) of the player's queue.

get_config.name: Get panel config
get_config.description: The panel's configuration (used by the panel).

seed.name: Seed panel config
seed.description: Used by the panel on its first start: its setup and photo marks. Never overwrites a configuration edited in HA unless force is set.

pick_photo.name: Pick a photo
pick_photo.description: The next screensaver photo from the configured sources (Immich favourites when none are set).

mark_photo.name: Mark a photo
mark_photo.description: keep = good on e-ink, skip = never show again, clear = undo.

get_marks.name: Get photo marks
get_marks.description: All kept and skipped photo ids.

set_output.name: Set the panel's music player
set_output.description: The Music Assistant player (or MA group) this panel plays its music to.

move_queue.name: Move the music to another player
move_queue.description: Music Assistant moves the queue (with the position) from the panel's player, or the given source player, to this player and stops the source; this player then becomes the panel's player.

entity_id.name: Target player
entity_id.description: The Music Assistant player that plays the music from now on.

source_player.name: Source player
source_player.description: Where the music is now. Leave empty: the panel's current player.

auto_play.name: Play at once
auto_play.description: Start playing on the target right away (default on).

sync_output.name: Sync a player with the panel's player
sync_output.description: Music Assistant plays this player in sync with the leader (HA media_player.join), or takes it out of the group. Answers ok false with the reason when Music Assistant says no.

entity_id.name: Player
entity_id.description: The Music Assistant player that joins or leaves the group.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: The player whose group it joins. Leave empty: the panel's current player.

join.name: Join
join.description: On (default): join the group. Off: leave it.

library_home.name: Library: Discover
library_home.description: Music Assistant's Home rows (recently played, favourites, recommendations, recently added / random albums) with their items, for the panel's Discover screen; rows with fewer than 2 items are left out.

limit.name: Items per row
limit.description: At most this many items per row.

sections.name: Rows
sections.description: The rows to answer, in the fixed order (recently_played, favorite_playlists, favorite_albums, favorite_artists, favorite_radio, recommendations, recently_added_albums, random_albums, podcasts, audiobooks). Left out: every row but podcasts / audiobooks.

library_list.name: Library: list
library_list.description: One page of a library tab (favourites first, Music Assistant's default sort), or what an artist / album / playlist / podcast / genre opens.

section.name: Section
section.description: artists, albums, tracks, playlists, radio, podcasts, audiobooks or genres.

parent.name: Parent
parent.description: A Music Assistant uri to open (artist -> albums, album / playlist -> tracks, podcast -> episodes, genre -> albums).

favorite.name: Favourites
favorite.description: Only favourites (true) or only the rest (false); left out: favourites first.

order_by.name: Order
order_by.description: One plain Music Assistant order over the whole tab (e.g. random) instead of favourites first.

album_artists_only.name: Album artists only
album_artists_only.description: Artists tab: leave out artists that only appear on tracks.

library_search.name: Library: search
library_search.description: Music Assistant's search over all media types (or the given ones).

library_play.name: Library: play
library_play.description: Play a Music Assistant item on the panel's player with a queue option. Play now wakes the player's receiver first (status powering_on).

uri.name: Item
uri.description: Music Assistant uri (an album / playlist when start_item is given).

option.name: Queue option
option.description: replace (play now), play, next, replace_next or add.

start_item.name: Start at
start_item.description: The track's uri to start the album / playlist from.

library_favorite.name: Library: favourite
library_favorite.description: Add a Music Assistant item to the favourites or remove it.
